claim: Prove division of the specific rational quaternion algebra B=(-210,5) by actual norm anisotropy and compute the exact reduced-trace discriminant of the same perfect integral order.

obligations.name: Same algebra and lattice
obligations.required_input: The PEL prerequisites require the concrete quaternion and lattice already constructed, not a replacement with the same dimension.
obligations.constructed_input: All six preceding sources are byte-identical. The norm is r²+210i²−5j²−1050k² on QuaternionAlgebra Q(-210,0,5), and the lattice basis remains1,i,(1+j)/2,i/2+k/10.
obligations.justification: All six preceding sources are byte-identical. The norm is r²+210i²−5j²−1050k² on QuaternionAlgebra Q(-210,0,5), and the lattice basis remains1,i,(1+j)/2,i/2+k/10.

obligations.name: Exact residue obstruction
obligations.required_input: A nonzero norm-zero element must be ruled out, not excluded as a premise.
obligations.constructed_input: The literal mod3 equations first force r,j to vanish, then after division by3 force i,k to vanish. Finite residue checks cover all3^4 tuples in both stages.
obligations.justification: The literal mod3 equations first force r,j to vanish, then after division by3 force i,k to vanish. Finite residue checks cover all3^4 tuples in both stages.

obligations.name: Unbounded integer domain
obligations.required_input: A bounded coefficient search does not establish anisotropy.
obligations.constructed_input: Strong induction on the sum of all four integer absolute values gives a strictly smaller tuple after dividing every coordinate by3. Zero and negative coordinates are included.
obligations.justification: Strong induction on the sum of all four integer absolute values gives a strictly smaller tuple after dividing every coordinate by3. Zero and negative coordinates are included.

obligations.name: Actual rational carrier
obligations.required_input: Integer anisotropy alone does not cover the rational quaternion algebra.
obligations.constructed_input: All four rational denominators are multiplied into one explicit nonzero D. The original norm scales by D², and the four resulting integer coordinates force each original rational coordinate to vanish.
obligations.justification: All four rational denominators are multiplied into one explicit nonzero D. The original norm scales by D², and the four resulting integer coordinates force each original rational coordinate to vanish.

obligations.name: Genuine division conclusion
obligations.required_input: Nondegeneracy of a bilinear form is not division of an algebra.
obligations.constructed_input: For every actual x≠0, the displayed reciprocal is Nrd(x)^-1 times bar(x). Both multiplication orders are proved1 and yield an actual IsUnit witness.
obligations.justification: For every actual x≠0, the displayed reciprocal is Nrd(x)^-1 times bar(x). Both multiplication orders are proved1 and yield an actual IsUnit witness.

obligations.name: Exact trace discriminant
obligations.required_input: A named discriminant must be computed on the specified order, including basis and sign.
obligations.constructed_input: The reduced-trace Gram is explicitly[[2,0,1,0],[0,-420,0,-210],[1,0,3,0],[0,-210,0,-84]], determinant−210². The same order alternating Gram has determinant1.
obligations.justification: The reduced-trace Gram is explicitly[[2,0,1,0],[0,-420,0,-210],[1,0,3,0],[0,-210,0,-84]], determinant−210². The same order alternating Gram has determinant1.

obligations.name: Period compatibility retained
obligations.required_input: The analytic period quotient must retain the exact order and sign.
obligations.constructed_input: No period source or order coordinate changes. Analytic consumes the same six sources and explicitly uses−E for upper-half-plane positivity; the new division proof does not modify that pairing.
obligations.justification: No period source or order coordinate changes. Analytic consumes the same six sources and explicitly uses−E for upper-half-plane positivity; the new division proof does not modify that pairing.

obligations.name: Remaining classification and geometry
obligations.required_input: Division over Q and an order determinant do not themselves establish maximality or all local invariants.
obligations.constructed_input: The exact local ramification set, maximal-order theorem, represented/algebraized PEL abelian scheme and original contact/moduli comparison remain explicit separate joins. No identification of genus5 contact Jacobian with dimension2 surface is made.
obligations.justification: The exact local ramification set, maximal-order theorem, represented/algebraized PEL abelian scheme and original contact/moduli comparison remain explicit separate joins. No identification of genus5 contact Jacobian with dimension2 surface is made.

obligations.name: Validation and provenance
obligations.required_input: The changed application needs source-level review and hosted kernel checking.
obligations.constructed_input: Read the actual accepted integer/rational descent pattern in AnchorAnisotropy; only the proof pattern is reused, not its ternary statement. Recomputed residue tables and exact symbolic order/Gram/inverse checks support implementation. Hosted Lean and independent bound acceptance remain pending.
